program_solutions:
(rule!
  (for/fold ([out g]) ([r (in-range (rows g))])
    (let ((colors (remove-duplicates (filter (lambda (v) (not (member v (list 0 9)))) (row g r)))))
      (if (and (= (length colors) 1) (member 9 (row g r)))
          (for/fold ([acc out]) ([c (in-range (cols g))])
            (if (= (at g r c) 9) (set-cell acc r c (first colors)) acc))
          out))))
